meta.attribution: Airport positions: OurAirports (community-maintained, may be incomplete). Radius: CAA New Zealand, "Flying your drone safely" and CATI 101-1.
meta.note: CATI 101-1 says not to fly on or within 4 km of the boundary of any aerodrome without a pilot qualification, plus air traffic control authorisation at a controlled aerodrome and the operator's agreement at an uncontrolled one. This circle is 4 km from the airport's centre, not its boundary, and is drawn at every airport in the open data, so it is only a guide. Use the CAA and AirShare maps for the real airspace.
